conditions.scope: Client uses JEM Bootstrap revision jem.17 and connects to a dedicated server that advertises a native AutoModpack generation.

change.summary: Defer server synchronization until login, expose managed files through the standard game directory and keep client service state outside gameDir.

modifiers.before: Ordinary Minecraft launch can fetch remembered server metadata, scan the active projection and prepare an update before the player selects a server.
modifiers.after: Ordinary launch performs no server update check. The native login query fetches and compares the advertised generation when the player attempts to connect.

modifiers.before: Forge can load managed mods from automodpack/client/active/mods, while players expect mods and packs under the standard game directory.
modifiers.after: Managed paths are installed at standard gameDir roots and Forge loads gameDir/mods. The internal active projection remains a rollback and installed-generation witness in the external profile state only.

modifiers.before: Client transaction, object, helper, projection and recovery state is stored under gameDir/automodpack.
modifiers.after: Client service state is stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%/JEM/pack-sync/<profile-id>. A verified one-time migration removes the legacy gameDir/automodpack directory only after every retained file is transferred. Dedicated-server state remains under gameDir/automodpack/server.

modifiers.before: Managed immutable files can occupy independent bytes in the object store, active projection and standard gameDir roots.
modifiers.after: Managed immutable mods, resource packs and shader packs use verified same-volume hard links from the object store when supported, with verified copy fallback. Mutable config, kubejs and defaultconfigs remain independent copies.

modifiers.before: Target paths copied into gameDir can bypass duplicate-ID disposition because the planned live target is already treated as present.
modifiers.after: All surviving gameDir mod files participate in duplicate-ID disposition. Unique personal mods remain, ledger-proven managed duplicates can be removed and unknown same-ID local files are preserved for explicit review.

cause.owner: Mods/JEMBootstrap pinned native AutoModpack source patch

rationale.purpose: Remove remembered-server synchronization from ordinary startup, keep the client game directory understandable and prevent unnecessary duplicate immutable bytes.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly required AutoModpack to check only during a server connection attempt, requested standard mods/resourcepacks/shaderpacks paths, requested no client automodpack directory and asked to preserve personal mods safely. Codex selected per-profile LocalAppData state, verified migration, hard-link deduplication with copy fallback and fail-closed same-ID conflict review while retaining native transaction, consent, trust and ownership boundaries.

introduced.summary: Use login-only synchronization and standard gameDir runtime paths.

history.summary: Use login-only synchronization and standard gameDir runtime paths.
Move client service state outside gameDir, deduplicate immutable managed files and include standard target paths in same-ID conflict review.

systems: Native update planning, rollback and object storage
relations: Server selection -> native login query -> manifest comparison -> reviewed transaction -> standard gameDir files -> restart when JARs changed
Client bootstrap -> verified legacy migration -> external per-profile state -> no gameDir/automodpack directory
CAS object -> hard link when supported or verified copy fallback -> standard gameDir immutable file
notes: The Bootstrap mod itself still loads with Forge. It does not contact a remembered server during ordinary launch.
BootRecovery may finish an already accepted pending transaction without starting a new server check.
Each friend receives a separate local per-profile state root on their own computer.
After the first successful dedicated-server installation, singleplayer can start without the server. Dedicated-only JEM systems remain disabled on the integrated server.
No registry, gameplay, packet-channel version, world, MineRENT or stable-profile change.
unresolved: Player launch timing, legacy migration and first login acceptance remain pending.
A changed managed JAR still requires the native restart before connection can continue.
